name: My Heart is in the Code
source:
A Visual Novel centered around personifications of the assignments from various School of Computer Science courses at Carnegie Mellon.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamecreation.org/games/my_heart_is_in_the_code]official site[/url]]
translation:
一部將卡內基美隆大學電腦科學學院多門課程的作業擬人化，並以它們為主角的視覺小說。

［編譯自[url=https://www.gamecreation.org/games/my_heart_is_in_the_code]官方網站[/url]］
